references.title: Independent high-precision checks and import notes

states.provenance: Liège AC-state library · independently checked numerical representative.
states.notes: An original library state omitted from the prior import was reconstructed from its Majorana coordinates and refined at the source-reported order. All reductions through that order and failure at the next order were checked independently at 100-digit precision. Saved coefficients retain 85 digits. This is numerical evidence, not an exact AC or maximum-order proof.

verification.method: Independent 100-digit Schmidt-matrix partial traces from the saved 85-digit components, through the next AC order.

records.sourceMethod: Normalized physical Bloch spinors symmetrized into normalized Dicke coefficients; largest-amplitude global phase made positive. Source coordinate precision is retained only to its original accuracy; 85-digit serialization is not85-digit sourceaccuracy. Refined at reported order7 using100-digit residuals, then serialized at85digits. Points matched to refined coefficients by110digit local Newton correction.

sourceCoefficientSelection.method: Physical-spinor reconstruction from previously unmanifested original coordinate file; no original Dicke file substituted.

refinement.method: Analytic real Jacobian and fixed approximate right inverse, with100-digit residuals and corrections; no higher-order search.

geometryRefinement.method: 110-digit Newton correction of each simple root from its original sphere point, using reciprocal charts; repeated poles are fixed exactly. This is numerical matching, with an independent Rouché check supplied separately.

records.scientificStatus: Numerical refinement at original reported order7 only; not an exact AC certificate or proof of maximality.
